description: Return operators whose FBA buybox share is below or above a threshold. FBA share is 0-100 (percentage). For a single NAMED seller's profile, the operator-profile tools (operator_classifier / operator_top_brands) are the better first call — this tool is for screening lists. Use fba_share < 50 to find FBM-leaning operators (likely carrying real inventory) or fba_share > 80 for FBA-heavy flippers. Supports optional brand filter to narrow to operators selling a specific brand.

brand.description: Optional — filter to operators selling this brand.

fba_share_op.description: Comparison operator for FBA share threshold.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

name: filter_operators_by_fba_share
